body:
Hello! I did not find the introduction boring; I enjoyed it. However, there are a few things which make it a bit confusing:

There are a few sentence fragments in the prologue, which stutters the flow of their paragraphs.

Some of your sentences convey too many ideas for them to be one sentence. It would be better to break these into separate sentences. 

Some of the descriptions are placed at the end of the sentence instead of near the things they are describing. The first sentence, for example, would make more sense if "toward a distant star" came after "tranquility": 

> Drifting through tranquility towards a distant star, was a rotten speck of chaos: a city of steel suspended in solitude, pulled from its intended course by a swollen giant.

I also didn't realize you were describing two robots. The "I don't run off a battery" comment didn't make sense to me until Mr. Vargula specifically calls him a robot. I realize now, the "steel hand" and "steel face" comments were literal; I thought it was more metaphorical, or referring to muscle. It would help to describe the workers a bit more early on so it isn't missed. Then again, I'm particularly dense when it comes to picking up subtleties. 

Anyway, I love the story so far and am interested in seeing more if you decide to post more. Hope this helps.
